item.title: Local reaction to confirmed Bluetongue outbreak
item.description: A Cavan man has been outlining what a confirmed case of Bluetongue would mean. Adam Woods, from the Irish Farmers Journal was reacting to a confirmed case of Bluetongue in a cattle herd in Co Wexford at the weekend. The Department of Agriculture says it increased its testing and surveillance for Bluetongue since the virus was detected in Northern Ireland last month. item.title: Man to face further charges in relation to fatal Monaghan collision
item.description: A 56-year-old man has been further remanded in jail in relation to a fatal collision in Co Monaghan. Ion Bucurica appeared at Monaghan District Court via video link today in relation to dangerous driving causing the death of the mother of two, Emma Mackeral. The Romanian national who resides in France appeared in front of Judge Raymond Finnegan over the alleged offence. item.title: Local councillor highlights need for public lighting
item.description: A Cavan Councillor has called for public lighting to be erected at what he has described as a very dark spot. This issue was raised at the recent meeting of the Bailieborough-Cootehill Municipal District. Niall Smith raised a call for public lighting from the cross where the R191 meets the R165 down to St Felim's National school and Bailieborough Soccer Club. item.title: Wind warning announced for Cavan and Monaghan
item.description: A status yellow wind warning will come into effect in Co. Cavan and Co. Monaghan tomorrow. Met Éireann issued the warning about Storm Chandra this afternoon. The warning is valid from 5am until 11pm tomorrow (Tuesday) in 13 counties, including Cavan and Monaghan. item.title: Increase in new jobs recorded across region
item.description: Enterprise Ireland has confirmed today that 69% of all new jobs were created last year were outside Dublin. According to Co. Cavan Senator Joe O'Reilly, this includes 139 jobs for Cavan, and 244 jobs for Co. Monaghan. Total employment across Enterprise Ireland client companies rose to 232,425, a net increase of 2,938 jobs over the year. item.title: Gardaí: Monaghan Town incident a 'personal tragedy'
item.description: The discovery of a body in Monaghan Town is being treated as a personal tragedy, according to Gardaí. The body was discovered at a site on the Cootehill Road yesterday. Advertisement A cordon erected by Gardaí has now been lifted.

item.title: Survey conducted by Monaghan farmers highlight dog attacks on sheep
item.description: A Co Monaghan farming family who suffered a horrific dog attack on their flock of sheep have highlighted their plight in Leinster House. In the aftermath of this attack, Eamon Monaghan along with daughter Niamh Monaghan made the decision to begin a campaign for meaningful change on behalf of all sheep farmers who have experienced the same horrific events. item.description: A Co Cavan undertaker has highlighted the importance of pre-planning your funeral. Mr Kieran highlighted that cremation can be contentious as a traditionally burial is still a primary choice for people. item.title: Ballybay-Clones MD to meet with Bus Éireann
item.description: Members of the Ballybay-Clones MD will meet with Bus Éireann over school transport issues. According to Cllr Sean Gilliland, it's a case of "postcode lottery" every August when it comes to securing a ticket. He told Northern Sound of an experience were three members of the same family went to secondary school in Castleblayney from the Lough Egish area.
